name: launch-art-portfolio
description:
Guides the user through launching a professional art or creative portfolio
from curation through outreach, chaining 5 atomic skills across
career-development, design-creative, and writing categories. Covers physical
vs. digital portfolio, platform selection, fine art vs. commercial positioning,
and curated vs. comprehensive approaches. Use when the user wants to create
and launch a portfolio to attract clients, galleries, or employers. Do NOT use
for building a job search portfolio in non-creative fields (use land-new-job
workflow), personal brand content strategy (use build-personal-brand workflow),
or creating the artwork itself.
